title: The Star That Emits a Signal in a Language No One Decodes
hook: A distant star broadcasts a repeating pattern that looks like structured data—but every attempt to decode it fails.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into the mystery of alien communication and the frustration of near-contact.

title: The Dark Matter Trail Leading to a Void with No Stars
hook: A filament of dark matter points directly into a region of space where no stars or galaxies exist—only silence.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines dark matter's eerie invisibility with the terror of an absolute void.

title: The Classified NASA Report on a 'Dead' Satellite That Woke Up
hook: A satellite that was declared dead and left in orbit suddenly began transmitting after 13 years of silence.
why_this_can_go_viral: Plays on fears of technology coming back to life and suppressed government records.

title: The Comet That Released a Cloud of Biological Matter
hook: A comet passing Earth ejected a plume—and spectral analysis showed complex organic molecules resembling DNA.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hints at alien biology being delivered to Earth, triggering existential dread and curiosity.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Only Hit One Hemisphere
hook: A gamma ray burst arrived at Earth but only affected the southern hemisphere—leaving the north untouched.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests a selective extinction event, raising questions about cosmic targeting.

title: The Black Hole That Threw a Star Back Into Spacetime
hook: A star was ripped apart by a black hole—but then its remains were ejected at near-light speed, intact.
why_this_can_go_viral: Violent cosmic spectacle with a bizarre twist—the star survived in pieces.

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That Is a Self-Destruct Code
hook: What if every advanced civilization inevitably creates a weapon that turns their star into a bomb?
why_this_can_go_viral: Dark, logical answer to Fermi that feels disturbingly plausible.

title: The Star That Pulsed Like a Heartbeat for 200 Years
hook: A variable star has been pulsing with perfect regularity every 2.3 hours for two centuries—no known cause.
why_this_can_go_viral: Biological metaphor makes it instantly eerie and memorable.

title: The Classified Soviet Report on a 'Second Moon' with Lights
hook: Declassified KGB files describe a small moon orbiting Earth that displayed patterns of artificial lights.
why_this_can_go_viral: Secret space observations and potential alien artifact hidden by Cold War powers.

title: The Dark Matter Cloud That Absorbed a Galaxy's Light
hook: A dark matter cloud passed in front of a distant galaxy and dimmed it by 80%—as if it ate the light.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual of light being consumed by invisible matter is both terrifying and fascinating.

title: The Asteroid That Carried a Piece of a Supernova
hook: An asteroid was found to contain isotopes that only form inside an exploding star—it came from a supernova.
why_this_can_go_viral: Connects near-Earth objects to stellar death, making them feel like cosmic shrapnel.

title: The Sun's Surface That Opened a Hole the Size of Jupiter
hook: A coronal hole opened on the Sun so large that Earth could fit inside it a thousand times over.
why_this_can_go_viral: Scale comparison makes the Sun feel alive and dangerous.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer That Is a Silent War
hook: What if every civilization goes silent because they are all fighting an unseen cosmic enemy?
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines war, mystery, and the terrifying idea that we're next.

title: The Classified ESA File on a Signal from Venus's Clouds
hook: ESA documents reveal a structured radio signal detected from within Venus's atmosphere—never explained.
why_this_can_go_viral: Venus as a hidden source of signals challenges assumptions about dead planets.

title: The Star That Vanished After Emitting a Single Pulse of Light
hook: A star flashed once, brighter than a supernova, then disappeared completely—no remnant, no dust.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mysterious stellar death with no explanation, feels like cosmic censorship.

title: The Dark Matter Particle That Caused a Global Blackout
hook: A dark matter particle collided with Earth's power grid—and knocked out electricity across an entire continent.
why_this_can_go_viral: Makes dark matter tangible and dangerous, linking it to real-world catastrophe.

title: The Black Hole That Sent a Radio Pulse Every 20 Minutes
hook: A black hole emits a radio pulse like a metronome, exactly every 20 minutes—for decades, no one knows why.
why_this_can_go_viral: Rhythmic cosmic heartbeat suggests hidden intelligence or mechanism.

title: The Classified US Program That Tracked an Alien Ship in the Asteroid Belt
hook: A declassified US Space Command report logged an object maneuvering between asteroids—with no human propulsion.
why_this_can_go_viral: Government confirmation of alien craft would be the biggest story ever.

title: The Supernova That Left Behind a Perfect Absorbing Sphere
hook: After a supernova, a perfectly spherical object remained—absorbing all light, reflecting nothing.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies artificial construction or exotic physics; looks like a Dyson sphere.

title: The Asteroid That Carried a Map of the Solar System—With an Extra Planet
hook: An asteroid's surface was etched with a diagram of our solar system—but it showed a ninth planet beyond Neptune.
why_this_can_go_viral: Alien cartography revealing a hidden planet is irresistible mystery.
